audit.whatIsWrong: TRICKY / 7.0 is right for 47.72% over 1075 games, but the page never says what makes it tricky, and the full-layer level chart claimed Akshan wins levels 1-5 and the lane is even from 6 — the exact inverse of the packet and of the content layer.
audit.why: Level 1 is Orianna's on range (Q 815 with a ball that stays); the lane evens at 2-5 as Avengerang and the passive shield come online; 6 onward is Akshan's on Comeuppance and swing mobility.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan with the whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Orianna line — 'level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar'. Level 6 is Akshan's here and the one-third figure has no source.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70s at 2500 range scaling on missing health; Command: Shockwave is 110s at 410 range on a champion with no dash. The item spike also favours Akshan: Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit, which is what your Q-W chip runs into.
audit.corrected: Level 1 is yours on range; 6 is his on Comeuppance at 2500; items favour his shields and swing over your chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most actionable interaction in this matchup was never stated anywhere on the page: Comeuppance stops on the first body it hits.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing damage based on missing health to the FIRST champion, minion, or structure hit.' A caster minion between you and Akshan eats the entire ultimate. The page instead told the reader Comeuppance is an unavoidable long-range execute.
audit.corrected: Stated in loading, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[4].why, breakdown.feeding, report[5].t and content spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing's terrain requirement was never mentioned; the page treated it as a free engage/escape on any patch of ground.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'fires a grappling hook into TERRAIN then swings around it', and 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain'. Standing in the open middle of the lane, away from walls, removes the ability entirely — and a body in his swing path ends it early.
audit.corrected: No wall, no swing — stated in tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Going Rogue's camouflage was absent, and so was the fact that Orianna has no reveal in her kit.
audit.why: The W flag is stealth and the ability grants camouflage plus move speed; nothing in Q/W/E/R reveals. That makes a Control Ward and a sweeper a purchase, not a preference.
audit.corrected: Landed in breakdown.mid, dontsFull[1].d, ahead and the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate fields credited Akshan with a 'reset' off kills: spikes[1] 'reset potential', spikes[3] 'reset off kills', content.mid 'reset off a pick'.
audit.why: Akshan has no reset. Going Rogue's takedown effect is that killing a Scoundrel RESURRECTS the allies that Scoundrel killed and grants bonus gold — a revive for his team, not a refresh for him. A reader who believes he resets will decline fights he should take.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the actual effect: a Scoundrel kill revives the ally he lost.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — it read 'His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down.'
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Comeuppance 100/85/70s, Command: Protect 9s. 'Fight while it is down' is unusable without the number that says how long down lasts.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns stated with the behaviour each one buys.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Slow-field his exit path mid-dive'; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Greed the third Q-W...'; dontsFull[1].d discussed ball positioning under the title 'Shove past river without flank wards'.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed on three of six bullets — each title promises a decision its body never makes.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to the decision its title names, grounded in swing collision, 800 swing range, and camouflage vision respectively.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended 'buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.'
audit.why: Zed is not in this matchup, and Akshan has no heal in his kit — Dirty Fighting grants a SHIELD, which Grievous Wounds does not touch. That line spends gold on nothing.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the purchase this matchup actually forces: a Control Ward every back against camouflage.
sources: brief.enemyKit P flags.shield (no heal flag anywhere in the kit)

audit.why: 'Heroic Swings' is the correct name used as a verb, not a misnaming — but 'charges' is wrong: Heroic Swing has no charges, it is one cast on an 18s cooldown that needs terrain.

Group with your team and use your ball defensively — your only path to winning fights is landing a multi-catch Shockwave while he's committed, not out-trading him in lane.

notes: Level chart: the full layer was the exact inverse of both the packet and the content layer — full read Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Skill/Skill/Skill against packet and content Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan, all seven rows in disagreement. Packet and content agree with each other, so the full layer was moved to them and phases[1..6].why were rewritten to match their new verdicts (phases[0].why already described Orianna winning level 1 and was left alone). Content win[0..6] needs no edit. phases[N].rating was deliberately NOT touched — see questionsForUser; the sides and whys stand on their own. Three high-value interactions were missing entirely and are now on the page: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits (a caster minion eats the whole ultimate); Heroic Swing requires terrain to anchor to, so an Akshan in open ground has no swing, and he is knocked off it by colliding with a champion; and Going Rogue is camouflage against a kit with no reveal, which makes Control Wards a purchase rather than a preference. Separately, three fields wrongly credited Akshan with a kill 'reset' — Going Rogue resurrects the ALLIES a Scoundrel killed, it does not refresh anything of his; all three were corrected. Packet suspectName 'Heroic Swings' in wants.you[1] is a false positive (correct name used as a verb), but the line was rewritten anyway to drop the awkward construction.
